mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes electrolyte depletion and volume depletion which may potentiate meclizine's anticholinergic and CNS depressant effects, while meclizine may worsen orthostatic hypotension from chlorthalidone.
action: Monitor for dizziness, syncope, and electrolyte abnormalities; educate patient on orthostatic precautions and ensure adequate hydration; periodic electrolyte monitoring is recommended.
